name: How long does it take to see results from an AEO Content Strategy?
description: Results from AEO can begin appearing within 3-6 months, with more significant impacts on traffic and authority typically seen over 6-12 months.

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to see results from an AEO Content Strategy?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for seeing results from an AEO Content Strategy can vary, but generally, businesses may start observing changes within 3 to 6 months. Initial improvements often include an increase in featured snippet wins and direct answer placements for specific queries. More substantial impacts on organic traffic, brand authority, and conversions typically accrue over 6 to 12 months as search engines fully process the optimized content and recognize its authoritative nature. Consistency in content creation and ongoing optimization are key to sustaining and accelerating these results over time.
